articles.summary: Congratulations to the winners and finalists of the 2026 Hackett Innovation Awards! Each year we recognize organizations using AI to redesign workflows, accelerate performance, and deliver measurable business impact across the enterprise. The companies honored this year are moving beyond experimentation – reinventing how work gets done to drive sustained ROI at scale. “They are clear on the value they want to deliver, they rethink how work gets done across people and technology, and they invest purposefully in developing the skills and structures needed to make that change lasting and at scale.” - David Ketchin, managing director of Europe, The Hackett Group®.
articles.title: The Hackett Group® Announces Winners of the 2026 Hackett Innovation Awards

articles.summary: The Hackett Group® has partnered with ServiceNow to help enterprises accelerate ROI-driven AI transformation. As a Consulting and Implementation partner in the ServiceNow Partner Program, The Hackett Group® combines Hackett AI XPLR™ with the ServiceNow AI Platform to identify high-impact opportunities, prioritize investments and scale workflow transformation. Together, we’re helping organizations move beyond AI experimentation to faster execution and meaningful business value.
